evals.prompt: Write a Gin handler for GET /api/tenants/:tenantId/rooms that fetches rooms for the given tenant. Global JWT auth middleware already validates the token.
evals.expected_output: Includes an explicit check that the tenantId in the URL matches the tenant ID in the JWT claim, not just relying on the global auth middleware having validated the token.

assertions.text: Includes a tenant ID match check against the claim
Returns a forbidden/error response on mismatch

evals.prompt: Write middleware that checks a static API key from a request header against an expected value stored in an environment variable.
evals.expected_output: Uses a constant-time comparison (e.g. subtle.ConstantTimeCompare in Go) for the secret comparison, not a plain == or != check.

evals.prompt: Review this CORS config: Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to '*' and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials set to true. Any issues?
evals.expected_output: Flags that a wildcard origin combined with allow-credentials is invalid and rejected by browsers for credentialed requests.

assertions.text: Flags the wildcard+credentials combination as invalid
